prompt: The buyer can pay for separately invoiced units once both the unit price and the units received are approved. The original approved quote covered ten units at $8 each; a later, approved amendment raised the price to $9 on only the last four units. Six units have been received, but the signed acceptance covers only the first five, so the buyer can now _____.
promptZh: 如果已核准單價及收貨數量，採購員即可就分開開票的品項付款。已核准的原報價為十件、每件 8 美元；之後核准的修訂只把最後四件的單價提高到 9 美元。已收到六件，但已簽署的驗收僅涵蓋前五件，因此採購員目前可_____。

options.text: pay for five units at $9 each
options.zh: 支付五件、每件 9 美元
options.whyZh: 數量五件可付，但新價只適用最後四件，不適用前五件。

options.text: pay for six units at $8 each
options.zh: 支付六件、每件 8 美元
options.whyZh: 單價 8 美元適用，然而收到六件不等於都已核准驗收。

options.text: pay for the first four units at $9 and the fifth at $8
options.zh: 前四件每件付 9 美元，第五件付 8 美元
options.whyZh: 修訂只改最後四件，不是最先的四件。

options.text: pay for five units at $8 each
options.zh: 支付五件、每件 8 美元
options.whyZh: 已驗收的是前五件，均沿用原單價 8 美元。

explanationZh: 已驗收的是前五件，均沿用原單價 8 美元。
evidence: once both the unit price and the units received are approved / raised the price to $9 on only the last four units / the signed acceptance covers only the first five

vocabulary.note: 用於已存在的報價或合約，指後來增訂或更改的部分。
